flashcards.back: Define urban local government, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define municipal roles, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore urban local government
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on urban local government. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where municipal roles is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach citizen participation to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
